claims: Trillion's orchestrator does smart routing: figures out which specialist owns a request, dispatches asynchronously, surfaces results, offers handoffs, tracks the whole chain
New agents can hot-reload into the roster the moment they are created
A well-optimized orchestrator reduces token usage ('stops token bleeding') while maximizing output
He has documented all prompts used to build Trillion over the past two months in a prompt library
how_to_steps: Paste it into Claude Code / Cursor / Aider against your own agent codebase to upgrade your orchestrator
on_screen_only: Browser at hellotrillion.ai/prompts showing prompt cards: 'Build a Head-of-Design Sub-Agent - From Vanilla HTML to a Composing Designer in One Session' (component primitives React.js + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + MagicUI + Framer Motion)

'Harden Your AI Agent Against Real Attacks - From Binary Trust to Audited in One Session' (log redaction, prompt-injection gates, timed approval for code execution, hardline shell blocklist, bearer-auth rate-limiting)
'Cut Your AI Voice Agent's Response Latency from 6 Seconds to 1' (pipeline LLM stream into TTS, hold-over-ahead)
'Lock in Your AI Agent's Personality So It Doesn't Drift Across Turns'
'Add a Voice-First Mobile PWA to your AI Agent'
Laptop shows the Trillion UI: glowing neural-globe visualization with agent avatars orbiting

relevance.why: Orchestration/routing and token discipline are directly relevant to Haji's Claude Code subagent setups and any 'Jarvis' build. But Trillion itself is not released; value is the prompt library.

implement_score.why: Cheap to try: pull the orchestration and agent-security prompts from hellotrillion.ai/prompts and run them through Claude Code in plan mode against an existing agent project. Review before running (creator says the same).

verify: Is hellotrillion.ai/prompts live and free, or a lead magnet behind email?

gap.what: Liked set has two other Trillion videos (WWWHH handoff note, board of directors) but not the orchestration-layer rationale or the hellotrillion.ai/prompts library with the agent-security hardening and voice-latency prompts.
